description: A muted teal court gown has a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and long paneled skirt. Narrow gold and darker geometric woven bands trim the neckline, cuffs, front and hem. An ivory underdress forms a central inset, while an ivory wrap with teal-gold borders rests around the forearms. A broad woven belt has round metal medallions and hanging tassels. Small earrings and brown shoes are visible.
